method: independent source, contract, controlled-vocabulary, exactness, closure, historical-labeling and no-fallback audit
rationale: Approved as a bounded Novgorod 1230-1233 Julian-calendar profile. The earlier generic annual table was replaced by historical Julian-date-aware authoring values and an exact GameTimestamp epoch.
limitations: Daylight values are calculated whole-minute gameplay reconstruction, not observed medieval clock readings. Dates outside the declared 1230-1233 applicability are fail-closed and require another approved version.
